name: youj-presets
title: Motion presets
description: Tailwind @utility presets for Base UI's data-starting-style / data-ending-style lifecycle: yj-pop, yj-tooltip, yj-dialog, yj-backdrop, yj-sheet-{top,right,bottom,left,start,end}, yj-toast / yj-toast-top / yj-toast-content, yj-collapse, yj-fade and yj-duration-*. Every duration is a youj token times --yj-motion, so Speed, prefers-reduced-motion and reducedMotion="always" reach them. Installing it writes the utilities into your app's stylesheet.
